script: This performance icon, originally a $500K marvel, now trades for about $300K, reflecting a 6% annual depreciation. Behind the iconic gullwing doors lies the heart of the 2008 SLR McLaren Roadster. Inspired by the 300 SLR Uhlenhaut, the SLR McLaren combines luxury with racing heritage, evident in its innovative gullwing door design. This hand-built 5.4L supercharged V8 pumps out 617 horsepower and 575 lb-ft of torque, propelling the SLR to 60 mph in just 3.8 seconds. Power is sent to the rear wheels via a 5-speed automatic transmission, complemented by an active airbrake. Inside, the SLR sports a square gear shifter adorned with the 'SLR' emblem, emphasizing its race-bred DNA. Considering its engineering brilliance and today's valuation, would you choose this iconic supercar over newer contenders?

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2008 Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren Roadster, finished in Crystal Laurit Silver Metallic with a grey soft top and a black interior. This SLR McLaren is owned by YouTube content creator and This Car Pod! host "Crazy Nick" Roshon, and was recently reviewed by Doug DeMuro. It was also previously owned by automotive media personalities Wayne Carini, Dennis Collins, and Tyler Hoover. Various associated videos are viewable below. This SLR McLaren is one of reportedly 204 Roadster examples delivered in the United States, and the odometer currently displays approximately 7,800 miles. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes 19-inch staggered Turbine wheels, carbon ceramic brakes, an active airbrake, butterfly doors, a power-operated soft top, semi-aniline leather upholstery, carbon fiber extra-large bucket seats, and a Bose premium sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications. Born out of a collaboration between Mercedes-Benz and McLaren, the SLR took inspiration from the legendary 300 SLR “Uhlenhaut Coupé” to become the Silver Arrow of the 21st century. Βased on a carbon fiber chassis and a front-mid-mounted supercharged V8 providing a tsunami of torque and a biblical soundtrack, the SLR left its mark as one of the most special Mercedes models in recent history. A total of 2,157 examples were reportedly produced in Coupe, and Roadster body styles, including 75 Stirling Moss speedsters. Power comes from a hand-built M155 5.4-liter supercharged V8, rated at 617 horsepower and 575 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 5-speed AMG Speedshift R automatic transmission.
sections.Equipment: A build sheet is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes: 19-inch staggered Turbine wheels Carbon ceramic brakes Active airbrake Butterfly doors Power-operated soft top Semi-aniline leather upholstery Aluminum interior trim Power-adjustable carbon fiber extra-large bucket seats Bose premium sound system Dual-zone automatic climate control
sections.Seller Notes: The seller states that paint protection film has been applied to the front end and quarter panels of this SLR McLaren. The seller adds that a paint correction was performed and a ceramic coating was applied by Elite Finish San Diego during the course of his ownership.
